facts.business: Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited is one of India's leading precision plastics engineering companies, providing end-to-end capabilities spanning design, development, tooling, moulding, and assembly for sectors including semiconductor, electric vehicle, aerospace, defence, medical devices, and consumer electronics.
